pages.text: While the Shrieking Obelisk is already effective at intimidating the Illagers who come hunting for you, there are always those forgetful sorts who launch a dull raid on your home while you're away. Therefore, you've decided to forge a new trinket to be rid of them for good.
By consuming a Tall Skull, this Skull Jar can unleash a terrible noise that reminds Illager hunting parties of their place—before they even find you. Simple and convenient.
Aside from effectively stopping Illager Assaults, this charm can also effectively intimidate Illagers, causing them to deal slightly less damage to you.
